name: bums.level.w1-01.name
authorNotes: Solo, no chain required. Spawn on the raised starting pier (top y=750) and swing (swing-tutorial, pivot 752,200, 530px bar, lowest point y=730) across the 200px gap to the middle pier (top y=860, x=900..1610). Arms only reach ~50px past the head, so each bar hangs ~52px past the pier edge with its tip a few px below head height: walk to the edge, grab the tip, pump along the body's own motion, let go on the forward swing. Every swing lands ~110px lower than it starts (a hanging head sits an arm-length below the hand) and a long 530px bar builds enough amplitude to cross; headless pump-and-release runs with noise (lib/bums-rush probe, 100 seeds) land >=85% on both gaps. A safety-net plank sits directly beneath the first gap, so a missed grab or a bad release in the first ~20s lands the player back on solid ground, never in the sea. Grab camera-1 near spawn on the way past (it is off the direct line so picking it up is optional but convenient) to be ready for the photo objective, then hang upside-down at the top of either swing's arc and use it (predicate anyInverted) for w1-01-photo. Cross the second gap on swing-crossing (pivot 1662,310, bar tip y=840, to the goal pier, top y=970) - this crossing is over the real void hazard, so it is the first point in the level an unforced error actually costs a life; an assist beam (striped chain) spans the same gap for players who want it, at the Clock objective's usual cost. No relics, ropes or crates yet - those are levels 02+.
